title: 6.1 Sol?
author: Hdale85
selftext:
Just curious what people have been able to do with GPT 6.1 so far and specifically Unreal or Unity or whatever other engine? I've been working on an idea for about 15 or so hours now and I'm starting to wonder if this model is really capable of high quality looking graphics in Unreal.  This first image is where I'm at currently, while the second image is the reference I used and it just doesn't seem to be getting there lol. I've given a lot of input back and forth and what we started with was a ton of files, references, an guidance built into a workspace. I've connected Blender and Unreal with MCP's and skills as well. Just starting to wonder if I'm going to do better as I've seen people that have done one shots on Opus 5.5 and had way better results in 3 hours lol.
